summary: Frontend-only test of the new switch-to-switch uplink UI on SwitchPortsPage (/switch-ports/10.10.41.221?clientId=da3d6e40-...). Admin login with 2FA (TOTP) succeeded. Uplink summary panel and 'Switch uplink' filter chip both work as specified. No crash, no white page, no functional console errors.

issues: Panel titled 'Porte collegate ad altri switch' also lists Porta 1 -> FORTIGATE-FW (a firewall, remote port wan1), so the heading is semantically inaccurate; consider 'Porte di uplink (switch/router)' or excluding non-switch peers. Same applies to the 'Switch uplink 2' filter chip count.
Minor: rows for non-switch peers show no VLAN, leaving slight card-height inconsistency (cosmetic only).

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Reword 'Porte collegate ad altri switch' / 'Switch uplink' or filter out non-switch peers (FORTIGATE-FW) so the label matches the content.
critical_code_review_comments: SwitchPortsPage.js is ~1123 lines - consider splitting (port tile, detail panel, uplink summary) into components for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: data-testid=switch-uplinks-summary renders with 2 rows: 'Porta 1 · Gi1/0/1 | ~ PROBABILE | FORTIGATE-FW (10.10.41.1) | -> porta remota wan1' and 'Porta 24 · Gi1/0/24 | VERIFICATO | SWITCH03 (10.10.41.222) | -> porta remota Gi1/0/1 · VLAN 1'. Clicking a row selects the port and renders port-uplink-detail-<idx>. Chip data-testid=port-filter-switch_uplink labelled 'Switch uplink 2' filters the port matrix from 24 tiles to exactly the 2 uplink tiles (both with uplink badge). Only console error is a pre-login 403 on /api/auth/me (benign).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found; the only remark is a labeling/semantic mismatch since uplink detection includes non-switch LLDP peers (firewall).
